objective: Run the frozen census and test the frozen predictions of research/OLD-CORE-20261112-001/preregistration.md.
status: Closed: refuted 2026-11-12 (frozen; 498 of 500 growths, two O global growths stopped unfinished; referee pending). The uniform-end law is refuted: dying cores have 1.55 to 1.74 knots per distinction and uniform resamples of their size never end (L1 failed; peeled, L1p failed though O's peeled cores sit near the known threshold, P_u2 0.23 and 0.43). Degree-matched resamples end every O core and no X core (L2 failed both ways); ordering by degree finds a dead prefix at least as early in 82 to 88% (L3 held).
title: The frozen census
